sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday looking to extend their impressive run at the top of the table. The league leaders have won their last four matches and remain unbeaten in their last five outings, sitting on 22 points from 10 games. Alsager have struggled significantly this season and prop up the lower reaches of the table, having won just once in their last six games, so Sandbach should be favourites to maintain their winning momentum.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town at home seeking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach, with both teams looking to build on recent form. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in what could prove a competitive midtable clash between two sides near the promotion places. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local contest featuring two sides in the upper half of the table. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir, a meeting of mid-table sides, while Barnton visit Shawbury United in a fixture between two clubs fighting for consistency. In the basement, Widnes Town's poor campaign continues as they visit Brereton Social, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face fellow strugglers Telford Town. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a contest between two sides near the relegation zone, and Market Drayton Town host New Mills as both seek to climb away from the bottom half.
